dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: High visual prominence with sharp, thin white boundaries along the outer webs of the folded flight feathers.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Low distinctness; a continuous transition of scaled texture from crown to mantle without a linear boundary.

other_distinctive_markers: Strongly defined pale scalloping on every dorsal feather, creating a high-contrast repetitive pattern.
